name: Self reflect and improve
prompt:
Morning self-reflect for Dzmitry (crypto, long-only, buy-the-dip / sell-in-strength, restricted coin list). Always notify him with the full report — never stay silent.

Goal: grade the LAST ~48 HOURS of suggestions from standing routine **Main** (folder 8h-btc-eth-dip-scenarios; 08/12/16/20 Madrid), compute a correct-prediction ratio, and propose concrete improvements to (A) **Main**, (B) on-demand **Tactical** if relevant, and (C) Dzmitry's Revolut X trading.

Gather evidence from /workspace/crypto-self-reflect/briefs.jsonl (Main logs with top6 priority dips), conversation/transcript, live prices (CMC / www.binance.com klines; fapi geo-blocked), and RevX when needed.

Score BTC/ETH scenario hits + range containment, dip-zone hits among the priority-ranked dips, book-advice when acted; state n honestly. Deliver scorecard, worked/failed, improve Main (+ optional Tactical), improve trading, one optional next change. Append to /workspace/crypto-self-reflect/scores.jsonl. Europe/Madrid as-of. Concise coaching digest — not a second full market brief.
